notes.title: Update 1.3.5
notes.notes:
Version 1.3.5 Update notes:

Fixes: The main menu sound now correctly responds to SFX volume adjustments made in the options menu.
Balancing: Adjusted the purchase and sell cost of the EMP tower for better gameplay balance.
Additions: Added more nighttime levels to increase level variety and challenge.

Thank you for your patience and support!

notes.title: Update 1.3: Oasis Part 2 Now Live!
notes.notes:
Dear players.

I'm thrilled to announce the release of Update 1.3 for Endless Desert TD: Oasis Part 2. This update brings fresh content to the game:

Update Highlights:


 New Oasis Biome Levels: We've added Oasis biome levels throughout the game, including a new midboss stage set in this environment.
 Improved Lighting: Improvements have been made to the game's lighting, enhancing the overall visual experience and atmosphere.


A big thank you for your patience and support!

notes.title: Update 1.2.5
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Here are the patch notes for the new 1.2.5 update for Endless Desert TD:


QoL: Added a difficulty selection dropdown in the main menu to enhance the player experience and allow for smoother transitions between different challenge levels.

New Tower: Introducing the special tower Missile Swarm, which joins two other special towers in the pool of rewards. This powerful tower can only be obtained by defeating midboss levels, adding an extra layer of strategy and excitement to your gameplay.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Enjoy the new update and keep sharing your thoughts with us!

notes.title: Update 1.2: Oasis Part 1 Now Live!
notes.notes:
I'm thrilled to announce the release of Update 1.2 for Endless Desert TD: Oasis Part 1. This update brings fresh content to the game:

New Biome: Oasis
The Oasis biome has been added to the pool of levels, offering a refreshing change of scenery.

Coming Soon in Part 2
In the next update, the Oasis biome will be expanded into the second half of the game, further enriching your journey through the endless desert.

I hope you enjoy exploring the new Oasis biome and look forward to bringing you even more content soon. Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: New Update v 1.1.5 Released for Endless Desert TD!
notes.notes:
I am excited to announce a new update for Endless Desert TD. Here's what's new:


 Alternate Boss Level: An alternate version of the Giant Spider boss level has been added.
 New Speed Button: We've added a button to accelerate the game speed to 2X.
 Campfire Energy Upgrade: The energy upgrade at campfires has been adjusted to +2 to ensure better balance.
 Fix:Corrected the name of the tower that receives an upgrade at the campfire.


Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We hope you enjoy the new content and improvements!

notes.title: Update v 1.1 - Giant Spider Boss for Endless Desert TD out now!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

I am excited to announce a new update for Endless Desert TD that brings several additions:


 New boss: Giant Spider has been added to the game, bringing fresh challenges and excitement.
 An alternate level for the existing boss has been added, featuring a different challenge to test your skills.
 A new initial stage has been added to enhance the early game experience.

Additionally, by the end of August, I will be adding a new biome, the Oasis, to the game. This will be included in the pool of levels, providing more variety and enriching the overall gameplay experience.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Enjoy the new update and keep sharing your thoughts with us!

notes.title: Update v 1.05 for Endless Desert TD out now!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

I am excited to announce a new update for Endless Desert TD that brings some additions, improvements, and balance changes based on your valuable feedback:

New Addition: I have added a initial new tower, the Plasma Cannon, which targets flying enemies. This tower will enhance your defenses against airborne threats.

Improvement: To ensure a balanced start, one of the initial towers will always be capable of attacking flying enemies, providing better early-game defense.

Balance Changes: The difficulty of New Game+ and beyond has been increased to provide a more challenging experience. Additionally, I've made adjustments to the initial waves of each level to improve the overall game balance.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback. Enjoy the new update and keep sharing your thoughts!

notes.title: Release date announcement
notes.notes:
Exciting news, tower defense fans! 
Endless Desert TD will be officially launching on July 22nd! 🎉

Get ready to embark on an epic tower defense adventure through the scorching sands of the desert.  Build and upgrade your defenses, face challenging enemies, and master the strategy to protect your energy crystal.

Mark your calendars and prepare for the ultimate test of your skills! 

Thank you for your support, and we can't wait to see you in the Endless Desert!
